title: Earnest Money, Option Fees & Financing Timelines in Texas (2026)
description:
In this episode of The Twin Cast, we discuss common homebuyer myths and misunderstandings that can slow buyers down or cost them money.
We break down what’s actually true in today’s real estate market and what buyers really need to focus on when preparing to buy a home in Texas.

From misconceptions about timing the market to confusion around the buying process, we share real-world insights to help buyers make smarter, more confident decisions.

Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer or someone who’s heard too many opinions from friends, family, or social media, this episode will help you separate fact from fiction and move forward with clarity.

👇 In this episode, we discuss:
• Common homebuyer myths we hear every day
• Why there’s no such thing as a “perfect” market
• What buyers should prioritize instead of guessing
• How the right guidance changes the buying experience
